title: Can We Trust Election Prediction Markets?
summary: Leading prediction markets have been heralded as “truth machines” — arenas for mass betting that reveal what people really think when they’ve got money on the line. On today’s Big Take podcast, host Sarah Holder and Bloomberg investigative reporter Liam Vaughan dig into what can happen when prediction markets mix with politics.  (Source: Bloomberg)
